chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Nay, by Allah! A believer is not a true believer ever until he acts as the body of his brother; when one vein in it is struck, it evokes the rest of the body.

key_terms.عَرَقٌ وَاحِدٌ: one vein (representing a specific affliction or pain)
key_terms.مِثْلُ الْجَسَدِ: like the body (metaphor for shared sensitivity)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a believer to be considered truly faithful according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the perfection of faith through the concept of *tadamuj* (solidarity), where a believer's spiritual sensitivity mirrors the physiological reflex of the human body. This hadith, found in *Kitab al-Mumin*, emphasizes that true belief necessitates an empathetic response to a brother's distress that is as immediate and involuntary as feeling a wound on one's own flesh. It underscores the Shia understanding of the community of believers as a single, interconnected organism bound by divine covenant.
